inputs: Scripted model floor-local-model-v1; fixed synthetic probe input and synthetic-done-v1 output; no provider inference.
Principal local-probe; idempotency key first; same key and thread replayed after clean process restart.

procedure: Run the captured repository entry points bun run typecheck, bun run lint, bun run build and bun run test. See commands.txt and scripts/platform-spike.sh in executed-source.tar.gz.

Use the unchanged pinned upstream workspace and frozen lockfile. Copy the authored test files byte-for-byte into work-floor-replay; consume upstream declarations while retaining the strict Floor consumer compiler/linter settings.
Build: deploy/start the native Alchemy Worker, assert its ready response, then destroy the local resources.
Admission: deploy local Worker and two DO bindings; enqueue a durable callback transactionally, make no polling request for 3000 ms, then read and assert the callback and completed canonical records.
Close the first harness scope without destroying its retained local resource identity. Start a separate Bun/workerd test process, update that identity and assert saved records/timestamps.
Enqueue the same admission key; make no polling request for 1500 ms; assert unchanged records and callback completion before the read; destroy local resources.
expected_result: The native Alchemy callback admits a Yielded agent whose alarm settles its scripted turn before the first request following the quiet interval. Completed canonical records survive a fresh local runtime process; duplicate admission adds no records. Build and restart cleanup succeed.

The first admission process closes its runtime scope while retaining resource identity for restart. The second process log records Worker deletion and CALLBACKS/THREADS unbinding. Clean process restart is not interrupted inference, eviction or power-loss recovery; identical duplicate records do not prove exactly-once provider/tool side effects. No browser, live model, D1, wallet or hosted check ran. Node compatibility was not explicitly disabled. Root independent technical review passed; later storage additions require a separate attempt.
